context.author: Codex /root/suggestions_evaluation, independent source-reading evaluator
context.labelMethod: Small documentation-navigation records and intended normalized token completions authored before executing production suggestions. Labels express completion utility separately from search ranking.
context.limitations: One evaluator and an authored English technical vocabulary plus three Unicode witnesses; synthetic partial-token intents, no frequency logs or representative user study. Top-five inclusion is bounded utility, not a BM25 relevance or automatic-input-rewrite claim.

text.title: Source provider
text.body: Source ownership preserves original text. Source source.

text.title: Atomic mutations
text.body: Atomic updates publish one revision. Atomic writes preserve coherent records.

text.title: Cancellation checkpoints
text.body: Cancellation stops pending work and keeps the current revision.

text.title: Metadata filters
text.body: Metadata predicates select records before exact facet counting.

text.title: Optional positions
text.body: Positions verify strict phrases and preserve original offsets.

text.title: Prefix matching
text.body: Prefix retrieval expands indexed normalized tokens.

text.title: IndexedDB persistence
text.body: Index storage supports recovery after worker failure.

text.title: Worker adapter
text.body: Worker ownership and recovery preserve one engine owner.

judgments.rationale: Complete source while finding source-provider or source-rebuild documentation.
Offer singular and plural normalized snapshot dictionary terms, not a generated sentence.
Complete metadata for predicates and facets.
Complete positions for phrase and offset documentation.
Offer actual worker/work terms with corpus frequency then ordinal tie-break.
Complete dictionary-backed index vocabulary including IndexedDB after basic normalization.
An unfinished prefix before the accented final letter can complete the existing café term.
Case-normalized Greek prefix can complete the existing accented token without accent folding.
Two Unicode code points including a case-mapped astral letter meet minimum length.
Unrelated prefix has no dictionary completion.
No implicit typo repair or search relaxation.
Exact normalized prefix does not strip café accents.
Greek tonos remains semantically significant under basic-v1.
Single normalized Unicode code point is below the fixed minimum.
Empty input does not expose the dictionary.
No analyzer token means no completion request.
